retry.exhaustion: Retain original destination and temp file; preserve error code and include both paths
retry.lock: Synchronous retry stays inside the existing transaction; no lock release/reacquisition or extra wait on success. Transient failure can add up to 2000ms of waiting while retaining the lock.

serialization: JSON.stringify(value) plus one trailing newline; no data fields removed
benchmarkMethod: One read-only snapshot of production workflow.json; all writes under temporary EDICT_HOME with workflow.lock held. Alternate before/after order for five writes each. Timed only atomicJSON (serialization, write, rename), excluding snapshot copy, DB parsing, and validation. Parsed all outputs and compared canonical JSON to the snapshot. Baseline atomicJSON loaded from git main:src/session.mjs, with imports redirected to local files; no injected rename failures in benchmark. Timings describe these local samples, not a guarantee for all filesystem contention.

largeFields.conclusion: physicalReads/physicalWrites cannot safely be omitted and recalculated with the current behavior; independent immutable files are conditionally feasible but require persistence/read-path changes and crash-recovery tests. No field removal, migration, or old Run relocation implemented.
largeFields.physicalGeometry: geometry records file device/inode identities and ancestor routes, including symlink and hard-link relationships, at claim time. Recomputing later may observe changed, removed, or rebound paths and requires filesystem traversal during admission. claim reads saved geometry for in-flight operations; blindly dropping it breaks overlap checks. Recomputing on every mutation may also increase lock duration.
largeFields.results: Operation results and item result bundles participate in deliveryComplete, independent acceptance, evidence checks and digests. They are durable evidence rather than disposable cached values.
largeFields.recommendation: For future writes, evaluate immutable content-addressed geometry/result blobs with validated references and transparent hydration. Keep existing inline records readable without moving or deleting old Runs. Persist blobs before publishing references; test interrupted writes, missing/corrupt blobs, concurrent reads, restart recovery, and unchanged range/digest behavior before adopting. Current tests do not establish those guarantees.

scope: No production EDICT_HOME writes, worker operations, push, publication, or version changes. Existing untracked slot-capacity reports preserved.
